assign.request: for these edge resizers, make them clickable (opposed to a drag), and have a small + icon button appear. this way, for any edge, we can click it, and then add an item. we want to be able to add anything (a row, column, child, sibling, section, whatever), where ever we want, simply by hovering. explore layout - any layout, in as few clicks as possible.
assign.now: scoping - read brief, ux proposal, and all of ext/Playground
steps: edge inserters (four strips, + chip, one insert rule)

log.msg: EDGE INSERTERS shipped. Four abs-pos strips per non-root node, revealed on .pg-selected:hover, each with a + chip on its own hover. The STRIP is the click target (a 12px band down a whole edge beats aiming at a centred chip). left/right => row, top/bottom => column; before/after by which side. Shift-click inserts a Flex, same as both other add paths.

PROOF 1 zero-jank: 10-point hover sweep on the 3-level holy-grail doc with body selected. WORST SHIFT 0.00px across every node, every hover, both before and after the CSS density pass. No scrollbar (scrollWidth==clientWidth throughout), no console errors. Affordances demonstrably revealed: 4 edges + 1 chip pair on node hover, + chip on strip hover.

PROOF 2 headlines, driven from the ux researcher's OWN seed (root Flex column, two boxes both fill). header/content/footer = 1 gesture (one gap-handle click) -> three 418px bands: MATCHES the proposal's proposed column. 3-across-equal = 2 gestures (direction row, then one gap-handle click) -> 129/129/129px, the same three widths the researcher's 7-gesture run produced. Proposal said 1.

FINDING - the 3-across discrepancy is real and structural, not a bug. The proposal's seed is a COLUMN, and the adopted rule only removes the direction gesture when the clicked node STANDS ALONE; box A has a sibling that must stay put, so its right edge correctly WRAPS rather than converting the parent. One direction gesture is therefore unavoidable from that seed. Driven 2 vs proposed 1 vs baseline 7.

PROOF 3 gap handle: click (travel < 5px) inserts between the flanked pair copying the left flank's size words; drag (+70px) still resizes - 201/201 -> 268/134, grow 2.07/1, child count unchanged at 2. Both driven with real pointer events.

PROOF 4 convert-vs-wrap. Only child: root Flex column + one box, right-edge click -> root direction becomes row, 2 Box kids, depth stays 2, ZERO wrappers minted. With siblings: L|M|R row, M bottom-edge click -> depth 2->3, tree is L | Flex:column[M | Box] | R, and L (530,111 150x90) and R (828,111 120x90) are byte-identical before and after. Only the wrapped slot changed.

PROOF 5 sidebar at 1280x900, worst case (a Flex whose parent is a Flex - both sections render). align's buttons measured at y=956 AFTER dropping order/shrink/basis: the proposal's arithmetic was wrong, because three of its five deletions sit BELOW the control it measured, so they moved it 0px. A density pass (column gap 0.75em->0.5em, section the same, seg button 0.8em->0.75em) brings align to y=842 - on screen. The full column still scrolls (scrollHeight 1247->1108 vs client 850): the readout and the in-parent section live below the fold, by design, and overflow:auto reaches them.

COMPACTION: toolbar lost {} / paste / dup / remove. dup and remove are now chips on the selected node's own chrome (top-inline-end, abs, opacity-only); copy/paste stay as methods with no button, keyboard verbs parked. Sidebar lost the order/shrink/basis FIELDS - the keys and their decls stay: a Box carrying grow:1 shrink:2 basis:10em order:3 still renders flex-grow: 1; flex-shrink: 2; flex-basis: 10em; order: 3 (verified).

BUG FOUND AND FIXED IN FLIGHT (1) - giving the in-flow .pg-add position:relative + z-index:2 made it paint above every positioned sibling, and a block-level + is FULL WIDTH: on an empty Box it covered the node's whole top edge and elementFromPoint on BOTH chips returned .pg-add. Static is correct - it hands the 12px outer ring to the edge strips and the corner to the chips, and keeps the middle. All five targets now hit-test to themselves on one stack node.

BUG FOUND AND FIXED IN FLIGHT (2) - five sidebar controls (type, width, height, pad, bg) rebuild the whole column right after writing, which wiped the readout attribution of the very change that triggered it. The last change is now held on the instance (last_change) and replayed by the first paint. Verified: grid prefill highlights grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr with the note up columns; width->hug reports width - removed flex: 1 1 0; a label edit reports label - writes no CSS here.

PRE-EXISTING BUG CLOSED (readme Left item) - a handle's orientation is baked into its class at render time, so flipping direction left the strips lying across the wrong axis until something else repainted. Harmless while a handle only resized; a stale handle is now a stale INSERT target too. apply_change repaints the canvas for direction/wrap and re-lights the selection, leaving the properties column and the attribution alone.

PARKED for the owner, as instructed: axis chips on edges (proposal Learnability item 2 - a direction/justify chip on the main-axis edge, align on the cross). It is also the only thing that brings the WHOLE properties column inside 900px, since moving justify/align onto the canvas removes the two tallest fields. Also parked: keyboard verbs for copy/paste, and insert-between on GRID gap handles (a grid's DOM-adjacent children are not track-adjacent - the same bound grid_resize_handles already documents).

assign.outcome:
**The edge is the insert affordance.** Every selected box now offers five targets, one meaning each: the `+` in the middle adds a child, and each of the four edges adds a **sibling** on that side — which pair of edges you use *is* the direction, so a row never costs a separate gesture. The slim gap handle does both jobs: drag to resize, click to insert between.

> An edge inserts a sibling on that side. If the parent doesn't already flow that way, the parent is made to — **converted** if the node stands alone, **wrapping just this node** if it has siblings that must stay put.

![edges revealed, 0px of shift](edges-revealed-0px.png)

| proof | result |
| --- | --- |
| **zero jank** — 10-point hover sweep, 3-level doc, node selected | **0.00px**, every node, every hover; no scrollbar, no console errors |
| **header / content / footer** | **1 driven gesture** — matches the proposal's proposed column (was 6) · [png](header-content-footer-1-gesture.png) |
| **3-across, equal** | **2 driven gestures** → 129/129/129px (was 7). Proposal said 1 · [png](three-across-2-gestures.png) |
| gap handle | click (<5px travel) inserts between; drag +70px still resizes 201/201 → 268/134, `grow` 2.07/1, child count unchanged |
| convert vs wrap | only child → parent converts, depth stays 2, **zero wrappers**. With siblings → depth 2→3 and `L`/`R` rects **byte-identical** before and after |
| sidebar at 900px | `align` **956 → 842px**, on screen. The column below it still scrolls — see the finding |

**Findings, not hidden.** (1) *3-across is 2, not 1* — structural, not a bug: the proposal's seed is a **column**, and the rule only removes the direction gesture when the clicked node stands **alone**; box A has a sibling that must stay put, so its right edge correctly wraps. (2) *The proposal's sidebar arithmetic was wrong* — dropping `order`/`shrink`/`basis` moved `align` by **0px**, because all three sit *below* it. A density pass moved it; the real fix is the parked item.

**Also landed.** Toolbar dropped `{}`/`paste`/`⧉`/`✕` — `⧉`/`✕` are chips on the box itself, `copy`/`paste` are methods with no button. `duplicate()` lands beside, not inside. Sidebar dropped three *fields*; the keys and their declarations stay (a Box with all three still renders them, verified). Choosing `grid` writes `1fr 1fr` visibly. The readout is one line per declaration and highlights what the last change wrote — including saying `label — writes no CSS here` when a word writes nothing · [png](grid-prefill-readout.png).

**Two bugs fixed in flight.** A positioned in-flow `+` is full-width and painted over both chips (`elementFromPoint` on each returned `.pg-add`) — static is correct. Five sidebar controls rebuild the column after writing and wiped the attribution of their own change — it is held on the instance and replayed.
**One pre-existing bug closed** (the readme's own *Left* item): a handle's orientation is baked at render, so flipping `direction` left the strips across the wrong axis — harmless while a handle only resized, not harmless once it is an insert target too.

**Parked for you** — *axis chips on the edges* (`direction`/`justify` on the main-axis edge, `align` on the cross). It is also the only thing that brings the whole properties column inside a 900px window. Also parked: keyboard verbs for `copy`/`paste`, insert-between on Grid gap handles.

Test document `pgmm-edges` deleted (`delete_current` → true); only `untitled` and `untitled-2` remain. No owner document was ever gestured on.
